author: Staff Reports
title: Tom Hatcher Charity donates $30,000 to Alzheimer's Tennessee - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Reports ,
6 hours ago
State Sen. Tom Hatcher visited Alzheimer’s Tennessee to present a $30,000 donation from the Tom Hatcher Charity. This contribution marks the 12th year of partnership between the charity and Alzheimer’s Tennessee, culminating in over $1 million raised for the organization since its inception.
Founded by Hatcher to give back to the community, the Tom Hatcher Charity also collaborates with the Boys and Girls Club of Blount County, reflecting Hatcher’s commitment to both supporting families affected by Alzheimer’s disease and investing in the future of local youth. The senator’s personal connection to the cause is profound, as his father battled Alzheimer’s before ultimately passing away from the disease.
“On behalf of Alzheimer’s Tennessee and our chairman of the board, Terry Payne, we extend our heartfelt gratitude for this generous donation from Tom Hatcher Charity,” said Janice Wade-Whitehead, President and CEO of Alzheimer’s Tennessee.
“Raising funds takes tremendous effort, and we are extremely appreciative of everything the charity does for our community. As always, the funds raised will remain local, significantly supporting our services and ongoing research efforts aimed at finding a cure.”
The Tom Hatcher Charity’s unwavering support continues to make a meaningful impact on the lives of those affected by Alzheimer’s in the region.
